name: Zylurian
description: Zylurians were a sentient humanoid species with blueish skin, long hanging nostrils and three fingers. The crew of the ZZ-class freighter Mingula consisted of four Zylurians who were all killed by a swarm of Ubuugan fleshborers. The bounty hunter Boba Fett discovered the corpses when he searched the freighter for valuables.
